      • getMemAllocatedSize

        public long getMemAllocatedSize()
        Description copied from interface: Backend
        Returns the total virtual memory size allocated via Backend.mem_map(long, long, int).

        This is the sum of all mapped pages tracked by the backend's native memory hash table. For unicorn2, this is computed from uc_mem_regions().

        Specified by:
        getMemAllocatedSize in interface Backend
        Returns:
        total allocated memory in bytes

      • getMemResidentSize

        public long getMemResidentSize()
        Description copied from interface: Backend
        Returns the actual physical memory resident in RAM.

        On macOS/Linux, this uses mincore() to check which pages are actually backed by physical memory, since mmap(MAP_ANONYMOUS) allocates lazily. Only pages that have been read from or written to will be counted.

        On Windows (dynarmic) and unicorn2 (QEMU-based), host memory pointers are not accessible, so this returns the same value as Backend.getMemAllocatedSize().

        Specified by:
        getMemResidentSize in interface Backend
        Returns:
        resident memory in bytes
